nodes.label: Initial project structure
nodes.content: First public scaffolding of Vellumli, a fork of Patchouli by Vazkii and williewillus for Minecraft 26.2 / NeoForge. Licensed CC BY-NC-SA 3.0, inherited from the original project under the ShareAlike clause.

nodes.label: Build fixes and mod icon
nodes.content: Fixed NeoForge API breakage, resolved compile errors, updated mod icon, and ensured proper JAR naming. Verified the mod loads without errors via ./gradlew runClient.
